label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Baycurrent Classic Leaders
items.text: Michael Brennan, Zach Bauchou, and Jacob Bridgeman finished Saturday tied at 13-under, while Adam Scott and Jordan Smith sit one shot back at 12-under ahead of Sunday's final round at Yokohama Country Club.

items.headline: Chacarra Plays Through Injury
items.text: Eugenio Chacarra competes at the 2026 Spanish Open despite a broken toe, balancing severe pain with his Race to Dubai and Ryder Cup ambitions.

items.headline: Schauffele Back In Contention
items.text: Xander Schauffele carded a 6-under 65 with two eagles and a double bogey to reach 9-under at the Baycurrent Classic, closing to within four shots of the leaders for Sunday's final round.
